verses.en_bbe: Then Job made answer and said,

verses.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
verses.pt: Como tens ajudado ao que não tem força e sustentado o braço que não tem vigor!
verses.en_web: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
verses.en_bbe: How have you given help to him who has no power! how have you been the salvation of the arm which has no strength!

verses.en: How hast thou counseled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.pt: como tens aconselhado ao que não tem sabedoria, e plenamente tens revelado o verdadeiro conhecimento!
verses.en_web: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
verses.en_bbe: How have you given teaching to him who has no wisdom, and fully made clear true knowledge!

verses.en: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.pt: Para quem proferiste palavras? E de quem é o espírito que saiu de ti?
verses.en_web: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
verses.en_bbe: To whom have your words been said? and whose spirit came out from you?

verses.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.pt: Os mortos tremem debaixo das águas, com os que ali habitam.
verses.en_web: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
verses.en_bbe: The shades in the underworld are shaking; the waters and those living in them.

verses.en: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.pt: O Seol está nu perante Deus, e não há coberta para o Abadom.
verses.en_web: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
verses.en_bbe: The underworld is uncovered before him, and Destruction has no veil.

verses.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.pt: Ele estende o norte sobre o vazio; suspende a terra sobre o nada.
verses.en_web: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.en_bbe: By his hand the north is stretched out in space, and the earth is hanging on nothing.

verses.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.pt: Prende as águas em suas densas nuvens, e a nuvem não se rasga debaixo delas.
verses.en_web: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
verses.en_bbe: By him the waters are shut up in his thick clouds, and the cloud does not give way under them.

verses.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.pt: Encobre a face do seu trono, e sobre ele estende a sua nuvem.
verses.en_web: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
verses.en_bbe: By him the face of his high seat is veiled, and his cloud stretched out over it.

verses.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.pt: Marcou um limite circular sobre a superfície das águas, onde a luz e as trevas se confinam.
verses.en_web: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
verses.en_bbe: By him a circle is marked out on the face of the waters, to the limits of the light and the dark.

verses.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.pt: As colunas do céu tremem, e se espantam da sua ameaça.
verses.en_web: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
verses.en_bbe: The pillars of heaven are shaking, and are overcome by his sharp words.

verses.en: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
verses.pt: Com o seu poder fez sossegar o mar, e com o seu entendimento abateu a Raabe.
verses.en_web: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
verses.en_bbe: By his power the sea was made quiet; and by his wisdom Rahab was wounded.

verses.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.pt: Pelo seu sopro ornou o céu; a sua mão traspassou a serpente veloz.
verses.en_web: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
verses.en_bbe: By his wind the heavens become bright: by his hand the quickly moving snake was cut through.

verses.en: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.pt: Eis que essas coisas são apenas as orlas dos seus caminhos; e quão pequeno é o sussurro que dele, ouvimos! Mas o trovão do seu poder, quem o poderá entender?
verses.en_web: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
verses.en_bbe: See, these are only the outskirts of his ways; and how small is that which comes to our ears about him! But the thunder of his acts of power is outside all knowledge.
